newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm oil refinery starts operations.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm oil refinery starts operations.

text.p: Indonesian Agriculture Minister Syarifuddin Baharsyah inaugurated a 1,000-tonne per day capacity palm oil refinery belonging to a state-owned company on Batam Island near Singapore on Friday.

The official Antara news agency quoted president-director of PT Perkebunan Agrintara, Suharno, as saying 80 percent of palm olein produced by the refinery, costing 52 billion rupiah, will be exported and the rest sold locally.
Antara said the refinery will obtain crude palm oil from state-owned plantations.
